text:
Alex Chen: quick ping — spotted a 404 in the runtime guide when following the kv-cache section. link: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/runtime/kv-cache -> redirects to /models/old-prereqs which 404s
Marie Gomez: thanks alex. i think runtime guide ownership moved last quarter? @samir any idea who picked up runtime-guide? :thinking_face:
Samir Patel: i took a pass at runtime onboarding but not the whole guide. i can own a tiny fix here if no one else is queued. what should we point it to instead?
Alex Chen: ideal target is the new model-onboarding page /docs/model-onboarding (canonical). quick diff would be replace the old shortlink. also the image in that block shows stale alt text.
Taylor Nguyen: i'm happy to review. can you include a quick note in the PR about the alt text change? :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: cool. i'll open a tiny PR in `docs` repo. sed to update the link: ```bash
# replace old shortlink -> new onboarding
rg "models/old-prereqs" -l | xargs sed -i '' -e 's|models/old-prereqs|model-onboarding|g'
```
Marie Gomez: fyi link-bot scan also flagged a handful of other shortlinks in runtime/* — it printed a list earlier. might be worth running the link scan across the runtime folder before merge.
link-bot: automated scan result: 5 affected files in /docs/runtime (kv-cache.md, batching.md, serving-runtime.md, compilation.md, routing.md) — suggested quick PRs or a shared sweep.
Jamie R: if samir is doing the PR, can we squash the runtime link cleanups into one small PR? smaller diffs make reviews faster. i'll add a reviewers label.
Samir Patel: plan: open PR with kv-cache link + alt text fix, run full runtime folder linkcheck, then if only shortlinks swap are needed i'll add them to same PR, otherwise follow-up. target to merge today EOD.
Alex Chen: thanks — pls @jamie r and @taylor for review when ready. also add a one-line changelog entry under docs/CHANGES.md: "runtime: fix broken model shortlink(s) and alt text"
Marie Gomez: note for private deploy docs consumers — if we replace shortlinks make sure redirects exist; if not, we should update canonical path instead of relying on redirect. pinging infra redirect team if needed.
Samir Patel: added a note in PR about redirects and marked it "needs-redirect-check". PR: https://git.internal.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/4829 (WIP)
Taylor Nguyen: reviewing now, leaving small nit about alt text phrasing.
Jamie R: quick CR done, left one comment. :rocket:
Samir Patel: addressed comments, pushed force-push, running linkcheck now.
link-bot: linkcheck finished — all runtime/*.md pass except two remaining external shortlinks (will create separate PR for those).
Alex Chen: perfect — thanks team. small wins matter. :clap:
docs-bot: housekeeping: added "docs-maintenance" label and scheduled a follow-up sweep next week.
